mode: built-in imagegen; one standalone image per call
prompt: Create ONE single standalone animation frame, landscape 1536x1024, of a realistic black and white athletic Border Collie galloping to the LEFT, full body strict orthographic side profile, against an entirely uniform pale light-gray background. This is a NEW pose, not a subtle retouch. REFERENCE 1 controls the entire pose and silhouette: forelegs reach far FORWARD toward the left, hind legs reach BACK toward the right, four paws suspended well above a ground level around y=850. The torso is long and unfolded in extended flight, the head looks forward, tail trails nearly level. Keep the first reference's shoulder, hip, head and paw placements and framing. Replace the simple schematic dog with anatomically credible photorealistic 3D game-character render, detailed medium-length fur with a clean readable silhouette. REFERENCE 2 controls only the dog's black/white markings, face identity and fur colors. IGNORE the second reference's tucked limbs and crouched pose completely. Four connected limbs only, natural elbows and stifles, long forward-reaching front legs, both hind legs trailing back, modest offset between far and near legs so all four can be read. No grid, no labels, no collage, no motion blur, no horizon line, no floor texture, no cropping. Soft even studio light, no dramatic lighting changes. The clearly extended pose is the main deliverable.
